name: MURIATICUM ACIDUM
key_symptoms: Cannot bear sight or thought of meat. At times, ravenous appetite and constant desire to drink. Achlorhydria and fermentation of food.
Vertigo; worse lying on right side; occiput heavy as if filled with lead. Sound of voice is intolerable. Pain as if brain were crushed.
Pulse rapid, feeble, and small. Intermits every third beat.
Urine.--Cannot urinate without having bowels move at same time.
Heavy, painful, and weak. Tottering gait. Pain in tendo-Achilles.

mind_symptoms: Irritable and peevish; fretful Loud moaning. Great restlessness. Sad, taciturn; suffers in silence.

gi_symptoms: Cannot bear sight or thought of meat. At times, ravenous appetite and constant desire to drink. Achlorhydria and fermentation of food.
urinary_symptoms: Menses appear too soon. Leucorrhśa. During menses, soreness of anus. Ulcer in genitals.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Heavy, painful, and weak. Tottering gait. Pain in tendo-Achilles.
skin_symptoms: Papular and vesicular eruptions, with great itching (Rhus). Carbuncles; foul-smelling ulcers on lower extremities. Scarlet fever, livid, with petechić; scanty eruption. Eczema on back of hands.
fever_symptoms: Cold extremities. Heat without thirst. Typhoid types, stupid. Hćmorrhages. Restlessness. Involuntary discharges. Bed-sores. Pulse rapid and feeble. Excessive prostration.
